subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should OpenClaw accept moving unconfigured embedded prompt-lock SDK retries to an OpenClaw-owned outer retry and resend path for the session-takeover race?
rationale: The code appears coherent, but it changes compatibility-sensitive provider retry timing, session fence ownership, and user-visible message-loss recovery behavior that automation should not accept as a pure mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept after green exact-head CI
options.body: Require current required checks to pass, then merge with explicit maintainer acceptance of the retry/session/message-delivery behavior change.

options.title: Split retry policy first
options.body: Ask for the steering/takeover recovery to land separately from the outer HTTP/connection/timeout retry restoration if maintainers want a smaller behavior change.

options.title: Hold for live race proof
options.body: Pause until a Feishu/DeepSeek-style production race is replayed end to end if deterministic on-disk session proof is not enough for this risk level.

recommendation.title: Accept after green exact-head CI
recommendation.body: Require current required checks to pass, then merge with explicit maintainer acceptance of the retry/session/message-delivery behavior change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest ownership across the embedded runner, auto-reply failure handling, and provider/runtime surfaces that need the policy decision.
